name: CAPRICORN
question: Do once-daily mirabegron 25 mg and 50 mg reduce incontinence and micturition frequency versus placebo in adults with overactive bladder?

design.blinding: double-blind after a single-blind placebo run-in
design.population: Adults with overactive bladder symptoms, at least eight micturitions and three urgency episodes per 24 hours after a two-week placebo run-in.
design.description: Multicenter, double-blind, placebo-controlled randomized superiority trial
design.locator: PubMed abstract, Materials and Methods; ClinicalTrials.gov NCT00912964, Participant Flow and Study Design

verdictNote: Both doses met both coprimary diary endpoints; follow-up ended at 12 weeks.
takeaway: In adults with overactive bladder, 12 weeks of mirabegron 25 mg or 50 mg once daily improved micturitions per 24 hours, and incontinence episodes among participants incontinent at baseline, versus placebo; the primary report found no increase in treatment-emergent adverse events with 50 mg.

reports.label: 12-week randomized results
reports.citation: Herschorn S, Barkin J, Castro-Diaz D, et al. "A Phase III, Randomized, Double-blind, Parallel-group, Placebo-controlled, Multicentre Study to Assess the Efficacy and Safety of the β3 Adrenoceptor Agonist, Mirabegron, in Patients With Symptoms of Overactive Bladder." *Urology.* 2013;82(2):313-320. doi:10.1016/j.urology.2013.02.077
reports.followUp: Final visit after 12 weeks of randomized treatment

results.measure: Change from baseline to final visit in mean incontinence episodes per 24 hours among participants with incontinence at baseline
results.note: The abstract reports significance for each dose but gives no arm means, effect estimates, confidence intervals or P values.

results.measure: Change from baseline to final visit in mean micturitions per 24 hours
results.note: The abstract reports significance for each dose but gives no arm means, effect estimates, confidence intervals or P values.

results.measure: Change from baseline to final visit in mean volume voided per micturition
results.note: The abstract reports a significant result for 50 mg; it does not give a comparative estimate for 25 mg.

results.measure: OAB-questionnaire, Patient Perception of Bladder Condition, and treatment-satisfaction visual analog scale at final visit

values.exp50: Significant improvement versus placebo on all reported scales

results.note: The abstract does not give scale scores or comparative estimates.
results.locator: PubMed abstract, Materials and Methods; Results

harms.label: Treatment-emergent adverse events
harms.note: The abstract reports no incidence or event-specific counts and does not give a separate 25 mg comparison.

delivery.label: Drug regimen and observation
delivery.value: Mirabegron 25 mg, mirabegron 50 mg, or matching placebo once daily for 12 weeks after a two-week single-blind placebo run-in.

relations.note: Same phase III mirabegron registration program; SCORPIO tested 50 and 100 mg in Europe and Australia.
Same phase III mirabegron registration program; ARIES tested 50 and 100 mg in the United States and Canada.
